# Modifications

The sources in this directory were imported from
`alonamaloh/schoenflies-lean` at commit
`05a43d29cde026618777db3d4e4316204ccca237` under the Apache License 2.0.

They include the reviewed Lean 4.33.1 compatibility changes carried by the
DifferentialGeometry development branch in
`schoenflies-lean-v4.33.1.patch` and
`schoenflies-lean-extension-v4.33.1.patch`.

Imports of `Schoenflies.*` modules were relocated mechanically to
`DifferentialGeometry.External.Schoenflies.*`. Mathematical namespaces and
declaration names remain unchanged.
